title: Upload
subtitle: Bring sealed runs, a project folder or an agent folder from your machine as a zip.

help.runs: Zip your runs folder (each experiment folder with its manifest.json). Every seal and the seals.log chain are verified; an experiment that does not verify is refused and nothing of it is kept.
help.project: Zip your project folder. Files under agents/, benchmarks/, experiments/ and policies/ are written; anything else is skipped. Existing files are replaced and keep their history.
help.agent: Zip one agent folder (its config, skills and tools). It lands in agents/<name>/. Leave the name empty to use the zip's top folder name.

drop.prompt: Drop a .zip here or click to choose one
drop.tooLarge: This zip is larger than {{mb}} MiB; split it into several zips.

failed: Upload failed. Check the zip and try again.

runs.empty: The zip held no experiment folder. To upload agents or suites, pick the Project folder tab instead.
